comparison.objective: Instill exactly one eye drop into a drawn-down lower-lid pocket and return the bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Light-force lid manipulation, precise bottle aiming, squeeze metering, and contamination-free clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one drop in the pocket, no tip/eye contact or excessive force, bottle released on tray, lid restored, held 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests delicate dosing and soft-contact control, not rigid-body screening.
